# Perry County, Pennsylvania

> > Official government website for Perry County, PA, providing public meeting schedules, employment opportunities, and county services information.

Perry County government serves residents from its seat in New Bloomfield, Pennsylvania. The site provides transparency through Sunshine Law meeting notices, job postings, and coordination with state agencies including PA State Civil Service, Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission, and PA Housing Finance Agency.

## Key Topics

- Perry County Commissioners
- New Bloomfield
- Pennsylvania Sunshine Law
- Public Meetings
- County Government Services
- Perry County Prison
- District Attorney's Office
- Little Buffalo State Park
- PA Housing Finance Agency (PHFA)
- Perry County Literacy Council
- Neighbor Helping Neighbor Food Bank
- PA State Civil Service
- Pennsylvania Fish and Boat Commission
- Perry County Chamber of Commerce
- County Employment Opportunities

- [Perry County Sunshine Meeting Notice](https://perryco.org/2023-perry-county-sunshine-meeting-notice): Official 2026 meeting schedule under PA Sunshine Law for Commissioners

- [Commissioners' Public Meeting - June 2026](https://perryco.org/event/commissioners-public-meeting-1000-a-m/2026-06-08): June 2026 public meeting at Commissioners' Conference Room, New Bloomfield

- [Commissioners' Public Meeting - November 2026](https://perryco.org/event/commissioners-public-meeting-1000-a-m/2026-11-23): November 2026 public meeting at Commissioners' Conference Room
